name: Screen Charm
soft_passes: #7 figure-ground: cornflower segments (#6C96FE) blow past 3:1 and carry the mark, but indigo-only segments (#614AF3) measure only ~2.6:1 on the #0A062E ground — under the 3:1 floor, nearly merging in grayscale
#3 silhouette: nameable only as a generic rounded triangle; the distinguishing weave is a color event not a shape event, so the silhouette alone is anonymous
#4 16px squint: gross blue-violet triangle survives as a Dock presence but the three-bar weave, hollow center, and vertex overlaps smear to a blob (provisional — 100px source)
#8 depth coherence: depth is implied only by alpha-overlap at the vertices; no committed over/under weave order and no shadows — no z-fighting but no crisp depth
failures: #5 single light model: no light model at all — no top-down cast, specular, baked micro-shadow, or refraction; two-tone is decorative and each ribbon brightens at a different end. Flat-by-choice decal, not a lit macOS object

#10 variant robustness: identity is the color-dependent two-tone weave, not authored as separable Icon-Composer layers; mono/tinted variants collapse it to an indistinct one-tone triangle and the personality dies

palette.background: near-flat ramp #0A062E->#0A093A (deep indigo/navy, faint radial center-glow; corners #0C052C, hollow-center reads ground #0B072F)

light_model: Flat / none — no top-down light, specular, drop shadow, or glass edge. Cornflower-to-indigo two-tone is a decorative brand gradient plus alpha-overlap translucency, not a lit surface; each ribbon lightens at a different end so no single source is implied. Only depth cue is a faint background radial center-glow. Reads as a printed decal on a dark card.
layer_stack: deep-navy squircle field with faint radial center-glow (#0A062E edge -> #0A093A center)
three translucent rounded capsule ribbon bars forming an open (hollow-center) triangle, cornflower<->indigo two-tone
alpha-blend overlaps at the three vertices (darker violet #1B1265) as pseudo-glass depth
devices: woven translucent triangle knot (three overlapping rounded bars; Affinity-suite construction)
two-tone cornflower->indigo ribbon gradient standing in for lighting
self-colored mark floated on near-black indigo (premium dark-icon idiom)
rhymes_hint: Affinity suite icons (Photo/Designer/Publisher) — the same three-bar woven-triangle knot, here a blue/indigo colorway; and dark-field flat brand-mark icons in the Linear/Raycast/Arc register. Style family: 'dark-squircle flat brand-mark / translucent-overlap logo'.
notes: RESOLUTION: only 100x100 WebP web render (Apple masters at 1024) — barely 6x menu-bar size; #2 grid, #3 silhouette, #4 16px are provisional, not from a 1024 downscale. MASK: PNG corners baked opaque white (#FFFFFF) — squircle pre-flattened onto white for web, so full-bleed unmasked layer discipline is inferred, not verified (composition sits well inside the mask). SUBJECT MUTENESS (key learning): for a screen recorder the icon shows no camera/record-dot/screen-frame/play glyph — pure abstract brand mark, subject-mute, would read equally as a design tool or crypto app. DERIVATIVE: construction is near-identical to the Affinity suite mark. BRAND COHERENCE: tight — cover uses the same near-black indigo field + periwinkle-violet accent (~#8B7CF5) + the identical triangle mark. ERA: 'custom' — modern squircle framing but glyph commits to neither Big Sur baked depth nor Liquid Glass specular/refraction; alpha-overlap is a flat gesture toward glass, not glass.
